Westbridge Veterinary Referral Hospital
PROUDLY SERVING PETS AND PET OWNERS IN WEST BRIDGEWATER, MA, SINCE 1975
While we provide professional veterinary services in a state-of-the-art facility that is equipped with the very best technology, tools, and options available, we adhere to what may seem to some as old-fashioned values. It is our belief that we are here for the express purpose of providing top-quality veterinary health care for each and every patient that we see, in a genuine and compassionate manner.
Surgery Services
Surgery can be a daunting word, but our skilled surgery team is with you and your pet every step of the way. Our elective referral surgeries are performed by our board-certified surgeon, Dr. Townsend.

About Us
The Westbridge Veterinary Referral Hospital (WVRH) has been serving pets and their owners in West Bridgewater, Brockton, Taunton, and the surrounding areas since 1975 as a 24-hour emergency and specialty animal hospital. Our staff works together for the common goal of providing pets and their owners with the very best possible care that modern veterinary medicine has to offer.
We are here to help you and your pet.
